questions.question: The Indus Valley Civilization was discovered in which year?
questions.explanation: Harappa was discovered in 1921 by Daya Ram Sahni.

questions.question: Which Mauryan ruler embraced Buddhism after the Kalinga War?
questions.explanation: Ashoka embraced Buddhism after Kalinga War.

questions.question: The Doctrine of Lapse was introduced by:
questions.explanation: Lord Dalhousie introduced the Doctrine of Lapse (1848-1856).

questions.question: Who founded the Indian National Congress?
questions.explanation: A.O. Hume founded INC in 1885.

questions.question: The Quit India Movement was launched in:
questions.explanation: Quit India Movement was launched on August 8, 1942.

questions.question: Who was the founder of the Slave Dynasty?
questions.explanation: Qutub-ud-din Aibak founded the Slave Dynasty in 1206.

questions.question: The Non-Cooperation Movement was suspended due to:
questions.explanation: Gandhi suspended NCM after Chauri Chaura violence in 1922.

questions.question: The Indian Constitution was adopted on:
questions.explanation: Constitution was adopted on 26 November 1949.

questions.question: How many Fundamental Rights are there in the Indian Constitution?
questions.explanation: There are 6 Fundamental Rights (Article 14-32).

questions.question: Which article deals with Right to Education?
questions.explanation: Article 21A provides Right to Education (86th Amendment).

questions.question: The President of India is elected by:
questions.explanation: President is elected by an Electoral College.

questions.question: Which Schedule contains languages recognized by the Constitution?
questions.explanation: 8th Schedule contains 22 recognized languages.

questions.question: Money Bill can be introduced in:
questions.explanation: Money Bill can only be introduced in Lok Sabha (Article 110).

questions.question: Which river is known as the 'Sorrow of Bihar'?
questions.explanation: Kosi river is called Sorrow of Bihar.

questions.question: The Western Ghats are also known as:
questions.explanation: Western Ghats are also called Sahyadri mountains.

questions.question: Which state has the longest coastline in India?
questions.explanation: Gujarat has the longest coastline (1,600 km).

questions.question: The Tropic of Cancer passes through how many Indian states?
questions.explanation: Tropic of Cancer passes through 8 states.

questions.question: Which is the largest freshwater lake in India?
questions.explanation: Wular Lake in Kashmir is the largest freshwater lake.

questions.question: Which organization measures GDP in India?
questions.explanation: Central Statistics Office (CSO) measures GDP.

questions.question: Fiscal deficit is:
options: Total Expenditure - Total Revenue excluding borrowings
questions.explanation: Fiscal Deficit = Total Expenditure - Total Revenue (excluding borrowings).

questions.question: The largest component of India's GDP is:
questions.explanation: Services sector contributes about 55% to India GDP.

questions.question: GST was implemented in India from:
questions.explanation: GST was implemented on July 1, 2017.

questions.question: Which gas is primarily responsible for global warming?
questions.explanation: CO2 is the primary greenhouse gas causing global warming.

questions.question: The Paris Agreement is related to:
questions.explanation: Paris Agreement (2015) is on climate change mitigation.

questions.question: Which is the first National Park of India?
questions.explanation: Jim Corbett National Park (1936) was the first.
